message: 2020-01-17 Historical backtest -- CPI surprise into overbought market (bollinger_pctb_20d>1) (CPI surprise (how far the new inflation print moved vs. recent prints, in std devs; only on CPI release days) above 0.0 AND position within the 20-day Bollinger Bands (0=lower band, 1=upper band) above 1.0 → short) Verdict: not enough history to judge -- 2 occurrence(s) found, too few for a walk-forward test.
